summary: Iteration 1 UI login hang is RESOLVED. Full regression executed on mobile viewport 390x844 against the public preview. Backend 21/21 pytest tests pass (auth, catalog, dashboard, lessons, syntax, quizzes, challenges, run-code sandbox, bookmarks, notes, profile, quiz-results, challenge submit). Frontend end-to-end flow verified: onboarding skip -> auth login (QA credentials) -> home with streak/continue/recommendation/daily_syntax/daily_challenge -> Belajar tab (search + lang grid) -> lesson detail (hero, sections, bookmark, complete) -> quiz (option -> next -> result shown with score) -> Praktik (simulator python outputs 'Halo, SyntaxAI!', playground HTML/CSS inputs & preview button visible, challenge ch-py-sayhello submit returns 'Berhasil! Keren! +20 XP') -> Progress tab (XP card, badges, bahasa progress) -> Profile tab (edit name -> save works, theme toggle visible, logout visible). API timeout handling (15s AbortController + Bahasa Indonesia errors) confirmed in /app/frontend/src/api.ts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~530 lines in a single file; still readable but approaching the point where splitting (auth, content, submissions) into modules would help maintainability.

Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the protected variable contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current /app/frontend/.env defines EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL so API resolves correctly, but keep both aligned if deployment contracts change.
run-code sandbox uses Python exec with a reduced builtins dict; acceptable for a learning sandbox but input length (5000 chars) + regex pre-filter is the only guardrail - monitor for abuse.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows: onboarding, auth, home widgets, learn, lesson, bookmark, complete, quiz, simulator, playground, challenge submit, progress, profile edit/save/theme/logout)

seed_data_creation: None (QA user and all content already seeded; test used existing qa.syntaxai@gmail.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_syntaxai_api.py. UI flow uses viewport 390x844. Direct URL navigation /practice, /progress, /profile works via Expo Router when tab bar off-screen. QA creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. All testIDs listed there confirmed present and functional.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 1 login spinner RCA: /app/frontend/src/api.ts previously lacked a fetch timeout and surfaced no error path, so a transient network failure left auth submit stuck. Current implementation adds AbortController(15s), rejects with Bahasa Indonesia messages for AbortError/TypeError/non-OK, and auth.tsx surfaces those errors to the UI. Verified: login POST reaches /api/auth/login, resolves <2s, and navigates to /(tabs) landing on home-greeting.
